comment: Per-asset provenance ledger for Polis sprite art (plan: docs/polis-sprite-art-plan-2026-07.md). RULE: no asset is committed to public/polis/ or tools/polis-art/ without an entry here; tools/polis-art/manifest.py (A2) cross-checks this file against the packed atlases and CREDITS.md. Sources below are download-level entries (raw/ is gitignored); staged/packed assets get per-file ids referencing their source key. Fields: id, source, url, author, license, modified, lightDirection, notes.

sbs-town.author: Screaming Brain Studios
sbs-town.licenseVerified: 2026-07-09 — shipped License.txt: 'released under the CC0/Public Domain License … commercial or non-commercial, with no restrictions, … with or without credit'
sbs-town.curationVerdict: REJECTED for buildings (modern urban apartment facades, wrong era); roof sheet possibly useful as texture material only
sbs-town.lightDirection: both variants shipped per SBS docs

sbs-textures.author: Screaming Brain Studios
sbs-textures.contents: 256x256 seamless texture sets: Brick(s), Dirt, Grass, Plaster, Roofs, Stone, Tile, Wood, Metal, Elements
sbs-textures.curationVerdict: ACCEPTED — primary material for A5a kit texture fills (plaster/stone/roofs/wood) and A3 ground/road textures (grass/dirt); free to recolor toward PALETTE

unknown-horizons.author: Unknown Horizons team (multiple artists — see their doc/AUTHORS.md)
unknown-horizons.license: CC-BY-SA-3.0 (art; some pieces CC-BY-3.0) per doc/LICENSE
unknown-horizons.licenseVerified: 2026-07-09 — doc/LICENSE on disk: 'Published under the terms of Creative Commons Attribution Sharealike 3.0'
unknown-horizons.contents: buildings (128x128 per rotation, tile 64x32 => x1.5 to our 96x48), terrain/trees (64x128), units with 8-direction x 4-frame walk cycles (~32x42/frame, move + move_full carrying variants: carrier, farmer, fisherman, priest, inhabitant, ...)
unknown-horizons.curationVerdict: ACCEPTED — Mediterranean subset curated per building (verified excellent: merchants/as_bath stone+columns+terracotta, merchants/as_estate1 plastered house); trees ACCEPTED; units = A6 walker verdict YES
unknown-horizons.shareAlikeNote: any edited/recolored UH sprite we ship stays CC-BY-SA and is flagged modified:true here + listed in public/polis/CREDITS.md
unknown-horizons.lightDirection: reads NW-consistent on sampled sprites; re-check per building at staging

yar-outside.author: Yar
yar-outside.curationVerdict: BACKUP for nature props if UH trees insufficient; light-neutral

oga-fire-9frame.author: see OGA page (recorded at staging time before any frame ships)
oga-fire-9frame.curationVerdict: CANDIDATE for A7 F1 crowd-fire flipbook; hero fire stays particle-based
